entries.en: The sudden anagnorisis comes when the heroine recognises her lost brother.
entries.zh: 女主人公认出失散的兄弟时，剧情出现了骤然的“发现”。

entries.en: The dedicatee received the first signed copy of the book.
entries.zh: 那本书的受献者收到了第一本签名本。

entries.en: The buyer inspected the stumpage before agreeing on a price.
entries.zh: 买方检查了尚未砍伐的林木后，才同意报价。

entries.en: They compared seismicity before and after the reservoir was filled.
entries.zh: 他们比较了水库蓄水前后的地震活动。

entries.meaningZh: 小片精肉〔烹饪法语借词〕
entries.en: A noisette of lamb sat in the centre of each plate.
entries.zh: 每个盘子中央都放着一小片羊精肉。

entries.meaningZh: 边防警察〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: The carabinero checked our papers before waving us through.
entries.zh: 那名边防警察检查了我们的证件，才挥手让我们通过。

entries.en: The animator redrew an inbetween to smooth the character's turn.
entries.zh: 动画师重画了一张中间画，让角色转身的动作更流畅。

entries.en: The relator handed the clerk a signed account of the events.
entries.zh: 告发人向书记员递交了一份签过字的事件陈述。

entries.en: As the family's last rememberer, she guarded stories nobody else could tell.
entries.zh: 她是家族中最后一个记得往事的人，珍存着无人能再讲述的故事。

entries.en: A homesick Englander at the next table asked where we came from.
entries.zh: 邻桌一位思乡的英格兰人问我们从哪里来。

entries.en: A chironomid landed on the page as she closed her notebook.
entries.zh: 她合上笔记本时，一只摇蚊落在了书页上。

entries.en: She learned enameling so she could add colour to her metalwork.
entries.zh: 她学习了上釉术，以便给自己的金属作品添上色彩。

entries.en: Choi brought a spare charger for anyone who had forgotten theirs.
entries.zh: 崔带来一个备用充电器，供忘带充电器的人使用。

entries.en: He hung the folded towel over the bedrail.
entries.zh: 他把叠好的毛巾搭在床栏杆上。

entries.en: The technician replaced the duplexer before testing the radio again.
entries.zh: 技术员换掉双工器后，再次测试了无线电设备。

entries.en: An old bayman showed us where the boats usually landed.
entries.zh: 一位年长的港湾居民指给我们看，船通常在哪里靠岸。

entries.en: The revolution brought a transvaluation of the society's moral ideals.
entries.zh: 那场革命使这个社会的道德理想受到重新评估。

entries.en: A sunbird perched on the fence while she adjusted her camera.
entries.zh: 她调相机时，一只太阳鸟停在了篱笆上。

entries.en: An early rejecter of the proposal, she later became its strongest supporter.
entries.zh: 她起初反对那项提案，后来却成了它最坚定的支持者。

entries.meaningZh: 土耳其狭长划艇；轻帆船
entries.en: They hired a caique to take their luggage across the bay.
entries.zh: 他们雇了一艘轻帆船，把行李运过海湾。

entries.en: The child tucked her babydoll under a blanket before bed.
entries.zh: 睡前，那个孩子把洋娃娃放进毯子里盖好。

entries.en: The engineers examined the heterojunction before testing the new device.
entries.zh: 工程师先检查了异质结，再测试新器件。

entries.en: I slipped the digicam into my pocket before leaving the house.
entries.zh: 出门前，我把数码相机塞进了口袋。

entries.en: We followed the narrow hutong until it opened onto a busy street.
entries.zh: 我们沿着那条狭窄的胡同走，直到它通向一条热闹的大街。

entries.meaningZh: 曼柴尼拉酒〔西班牙雪利酒〕
entries.en: She ordered a glass of manzanilla while waiting for her friends.
entries.zh: 等朋友时，她点了一杯曼柴尼拉酒。

entries.meaningZh: 传统习惯法〔印度尼西亚语借词〕
entries.en: The families disagreed over how adat applied to the boundary dispute.
entries.zh: 几家人对传统习惯法应如何适用于那场地界纠纷意见不一。

entries.en: Reinhold carried the sleeping puppy inside when the rain began.
entries.zh: 下雨时，莱因霍尔德把熟睡的小狗抱进了屋。

entries.en: The pamphlet's agrarianism appealed to farmers who owned no land.
entries.zh: 那本小册子倡导平均地权，吸引了没有土地的农民。

entries.meaningZh: 凭感觉当真的虚假真实感〔非正式〕
entries.en: The speech relied on truthiness rather than evidence, and she noticed.
entries.zh: 她听出来了，那番演讲靠的是让人感觉真实，而不是证据。

entries.meaningZh: 胡椒味大蒜酱〔法语借词〕
entries.en: He spread rouille on a slice of bread beside his soup.
entries.zh: 他在汤旁的一片面包上抹了胡椒味大蒜酱。

entries.en: The recision of the contract left both companies looking for new partners.
entries.zh: 合同取消后，两家公司都得寻找新的合作伙伴。

entries.en: A carved palmette decorated the centre of the wooden panel.
entries.zh: 木板中央装饰着一枚雕刻的棕叶饰。

entries.en: The experiment tested whether allelopathy explained the seedlings' poor growth.
entries.zh: 实验检验了幼苗生长不良是否由植化相克引起。

entries.en: She hung the dreamcatcher above her bed, beside a photograph.
entries.zh: 她把捕梦网挂在床头上方的一张照片旁边。

entries.en: The crowded waiting room faced a single flickering telescreen.
entries.zh: 拥挤候诊室里的座位都朝着唯一一块闪烁的电视屏幕。

entries.en: The mechanic covered the Lamborghini before closing the workshop.
entries.zh: 修理工在关门前给那辆兰博基尼盖上了罩布。

entries.en: Her objections to emotivism led to a lively debate after the lecture.
entries.zh: 她对情绪主义的异议，在讲座后引发了一场热烈辩论。

entries.meaningZh: 水生附着生物〔集合称呼〕
entries.en: A film of periphyton coated the stones in the stream.
entries.zh: 溪流中的石头上覆盖着一层水生附着生物。

entries.en: The firm hired a telematics specialist to review its vehicle data.
entries.zh: 公司聘请了一位远程信息处理专家，审查车辆数据。

entries.en: The glassmaker swept the cullet into a separate bin.
entries.zh: 玻璃工把碎玻璃扫进了一个单独的箱子里。

entries.en: The veterinarian suspected babesiosis but waited for the laboratory results.
entries.zh: 兽医怀疑是巴贝西虫病，但仍等待实验室的检验结果。

entries.en: The new clean room gave the microfabrication team more space to work.
entries.zh: 新的洁净室让微细加工团队有了更大的工作空间。

entries.en: Through the telescope, she traced a rille across the Moon's surface.
entries.zh: 她透过望远镜，沿着月球表面的一道沟纹看去。

entries.en: The team compared two methods of trapping antihydrogen.
entries.zh: 团队比较了两种俘获反氢的方法。

entries.en: They set the chequerboard between them and began a quiet game.
entries.zh: 他们把西洋跳棋棋盘放在两人中间，安静地下起了棋。

entries.meaningZh: 人头税纳税人〔旧税制用语〕
entries.en: The chargepayer disputed the amount listed on the notice.
entries.zh: 那位人头税纳税人对通知单上列出的金额提出了异议。

entries.en: The engineers cut the metamaterial into panels for the prototype.
entries.zh: 工程师把那种超材料切成板材，用于制作原型。

entries.en: Her reiki appointment was cancelled when the practitioner fell ill.
entries.zh: 从业者生病了，她预约的灵气疗法服务因而取消。

entries.en: The Susu guest offered to help us prepare the evening meal.
entries.zh: 那位苏苏族客人主动提出帮我们准备晚饭。

entries.en: The satellite image showed a break in the storm's eyewall.
entries.zh: 卫星图像显示，那场风暴的眼壁上有一个缺口。

entries.en: The Xhosa in her story returns home to care for his father.
entries.zh: 她故事里的那位科萨人回家照顾父亲。

entries.en: They gathered at the hearthside to listen to her story.
entries.zh: 他们聚在炉边，听她讲故事。

entries.en: Shawn borrowed a ladder to retrieve the kite from the roof.
entries.zh: 肖恩借了一把梯子，去取屋顶上的风筝。

entries.en: A change of context produced a different interpretant of the same sign.
entries.zh: 语境的改变，使同一个符号产生了不同的解释项。

entries.en: The office doomster predicted disaster whenever anyone proposed a change.
entries.zh: 办公室里那个悲观的灾难预言者，一听见有人提议改变就说要出事。

entries.en: A gentoo waddled past the camera and disappeared behind a rock.
entries.zh: 一只巴布亚企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过镜头前，消失在岩石后面。

entries.en: Each allottee received a map showing the boundaries of the plot.
entries.zh: 每位获分配土地的人都拿到了一张标明地块边界的地图。

entries.en: Diya took the last empty seat beside the window.
entries.zh: 迪亚坐到了窗边最后一个空座位上。

entries.en: The young draftnik handed out leaflets outside the station.
entries.zh: 那位年轻的反征兵者在车站外分发传单。

entries.en: The choir rehearsed the Sanctus after a short break.
entries.zh: 短暂休息后，合唱团排练了三圣颂。

entries.en: She left agentry to manage the estate herself.
entries.zh: 她不再从事代理业务，转而亲自管理那处庄园。

entries.meaningZh: 斗牛士用的红布〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: The matador draped the muleta over his arm before entering the ring.
entries.zh: 斗牛士把红布搭在手臂上，然后走进了斗牛场。

entries.meaningZh: 巴基斯坦佬〔英式种族侮辱语〕
entries.en: He was called a Paki at the bus stop, and a stranger intervened.
entries.zh: 有人在公交站用针对巴基斯坦人的脏话辱骂他，一位陌生人出面制止。

entries.en: A Cree in the novel opens a printing shop with her older brother.
entries.zh: 小说中，一位克里族人与哥哥一起开了一家印刷店。

entries.en: He put his unlit ciggy back in the packet.
entries.zh: 他把那支没点燃的香烟放回了烟盒。

entries.en: The chargehand divided the repair work between the two crews.
entries.zh: 领班把维修工作分配给了两个小组。

entries.en: Travel unsettled the Weltanschauung he had inherited from his family.
entries.zh: 旅行动摇了他从家庭承袭而来的世界观。

entries.en: One wellie filled with water before she could reach dry ground.
entries.zh: 她还没走到干地，一只长筒雨靴就灌满了水。

entries.en: The archive supplied the newspaper on microform rather than in bound volumes.
entries.zh: 档案馆提供了那份报纸的缩微印刷品，而不是合订本。

entries.meaningZh: 铰接式卡车〔英式非正式简称〕
entries.en: An artic blocked the narrow entrance while the driver checked his map.
entries.zh: 司机查看地图时，一辆铰接式卡车堵住了狭窄的入口。

entries.meaningZh: 阿根廷佬〔英式侮辱性俚语〕
entries.en: He objected when the commentator dismissed the player as an Argy.
entries.zh: 解说员用贬称叫那位球员“阿根廷佬”，他对此表示反对。

entries.en: Svetlana put a fresh notebook beside the telephone.
entries.zh: 斯维特拉娜在电话旁放了一本新笔记本。

entries.en: Mr Spector returned the keys before the office closed.
entries.zh: 斯佩克特先生在办公室关门前归还了钥匙。

entries.en: Grady offered to wait with us until the bus arrived.
entries.zh: 格雷迪主动提出陪我们等到公交车来。

entries.en: The manager checked the stocklist before ordering more paper.
entries.zh: 经理核对库存货物表后，才又订购了纸张。

entries.en: The statist checked the totals twice before handing over the tables.
entries.zh: 那位统计学者核对了两遍总数，才交出了表格。

entries.en: The technician tested the damaged files for recoverability.
entries.zh: 技术员测试了受损文件的可恢复性。

entries.en: The extra customisation delayed delivery of the handmade desk.
entries.zh: 额外的定制要求推迟了那张手工书桌的交付。

entries.en: Carmina wrapped the fragile bowl in a thick towel.
entries.zh: 卡尔米纳用一条厚毛巾包好了那个易碎的碗。

entries.en: She put the unopened Campari beside the glasses on the sideboard.
entries.zh: 她把未开封的堪培利酒放在餐边柜的玻璃杯旁。

entries.en: In the scene, Kiki lends her umbrella to a stranger.
entries.zh: 在这个场景中，林子萱把伞借给了一位陌生人。

entries.en: Juanita noticed a loose button and fetched her sewing kit.
entries.zh: 胡安妮塔发现一个纽扣松了，便取来了针线盒。

entries.en: The driver parked the Isuzu beside the loading bay.
entries.zh: 司机把那辆五十铃停在了装卸区旁边。

entries.en: Hedda brought a basket for the apples we had picked.
entries.zh: 海达拿来一个篮子，装我们摘的苹果。

entries.meaningZh: 弗雷〔瑞士足球运动员名〕
entries.en: In the story, Frei greets a young fan outside the ground.
entries.zh: 故事中，弗雷在球场外向一位小球迷打招呼。

entries.en: He brought out the calvados after the guests had finished dessert.
entries.zh: 客人吃完甜点后，他拿出了陈年苹果白兰地。

entries.en: The red sportscar barely fitted through the garage door.
entries.zh: 那辆红色跑车勉强开过了车库门。

entries.en: His support for Chartism caused a lasting quarrel with his employer.
entries.zh: 他支持宪章运动，因此与雇主长期不和。

entries.en: The addenda corrected two dates in the original report.
entries.zh: 补遗纠正了原报告中的两个日期。

entries.en: Our friends in Nanjing kept the parcel until we arrived.
entries.zh: 我们在南京的朋友保管着包裹，等我们到来。

entries.en: The family packed their Espace with bags for the weekend trip.
entries.zh: 那家人把埃斯佩斯车里装满行李，准备周末出游。

entries.en: They sent the spare key to a friend in Abidjan.
entries.zh: 他们把备用钥匙寄给了住在阿比让的一位朋友。

entries.meaningZh: 指节铜套〔英式，常用复数〕
entries.en: The officer found a knuckleduster beneath the car seat.
entries.zh: 警察在汽车座位下面发现了一个指节铜套。

entries.en: The evaluators questioned the additionality of a project that was already fully funded.
entries.zh: 评估者质疑一个早已资金充足的项目是否具有额外性。

entries.en: The old kirkman unlocked the side door for the waiting visitors.
entries.zh: 那位年长的苏格兰教会教徒为等候的访客打开了侧门。

entries.en: The children imagined a bogle hiding behind the crooked tree.
entries.zh: 孩子们想象那棵歪树后面藏着一个妖怪。

entries.en: Bello found a quiet corner to finish the letter.
entries.zh: 贝罗找了个安静的角落，把信写完。

entries.en: The Tatar in her novel repairs clocks in a small workshop.
entries.zh: 她小说里的那位鞑靼人在一间小工坊里修钟。

entries.en: The boat passed a low skerry before turning towards the harbour.
entries.zh: 船经过一座低矮的岩石小岛，转向了港口。

entries.meaningZh: 法理社会〔社会学德语借词〕
entries.en: Her account of Gesellschaft emphasised contracts rather than family ties.
entries.zh: 她对法理社会的论述，强调的是契约而不是亲属纽带。

entries.en: She listed her cohabitee as the emergency contact on the form.
entries.zh: 她在表格上把同居伴侣列为紧急联系人。

entries.en: Zachary put the wet boots beside the back door.
entries.zh: 扎卡里把湿靴子放在后门旁。

entries.en: The bakery used wholewheat for its darker loaves.
entries.zh: 那家面包店用全麦制作颜色较深的面包。

entries.meaningZh: 基本原理〔拉丁语借词，复数〕
entries.en: The lecturer returned to the principia whenever the argument became tangled.
entries.zh: 每当论证变得纠结，讲师就回到基本原理上来。

entries.en: Gian carried the empty bottles down to the recycling bin.
entries.zh: 吉安把空瓶子搬下楼，放进回收箱。

entries.en: The suitcase she had lost finally reached her hotel in Galle.
entries.zh: 她丢失的行李箱终于送到了她在加勒入住的酒店。

entries.meaningZh: 罗卜〔生理学家及生物学家名〕
entries.en: In her play, Loeb finds a sealed envelope beneath his notebook.
entries.zh: 在她的戏中，罗卜在笔记本下面发现了一个封好的信封。

entries.en: Clementina waited beside the lift with a box of books.
entries.zh: 克莱门蒂娜拿着一箱书，在电梯旁等候。

entries.en: A Samian at the next table helped us read the handwritten note.
entries.zh: 邻桌一位萨摩斯岛居民帮我们辨认了那张手写便条。

entries.en: The child left her pogo leaning against the garage wall.
entries.zh: 那个孩子把弹簧单高跷靠在了车库墙上。

entries.en: A fictional messenger brings urgent news to the Hohenzollern court.
entries.zh: 一位虚构的信使向霍亨索伦王室带来紧急消息。

entries.en: Garde left a note explaining where he had put the tools.
entries.zh: 加尔达留下一张便条，说明工具放在了哪里。

entries.en: They sat on the kang to mend the torn blankets.
entries.zh: 他们坐在炕上缝补破毯子。

entries.meaningZh: 德语艺术歌曲〔德语借词，复数〕
entries.en: The recital paired lieder with readings from the singer's letters.
entries.zh: 那场独唱会把德语艺术歌曲演唱与歌手书信的朗读结合了起来。

entries.en: Khaled brought a spare blanket for the overnight train journey.
entries.zh: 卡勒德为过夜的火车旅程多带了一条毯子。

entries.en: The despatcher assigned the next task to an idle processor.
entries.zh: 调度程序把下一项任务分派给了一个空闲的处理器。

entries.meaningZh: 班图斯坦〔南非种族隔离时期的隔离地区〕
entries.en: The novel follows a family forced to move to a bantustan.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一个被迫迁往班图斯坦地区的家庭的经历。

entries.en: Her stepchildren helped her plant the garden that spring.
entries.zh: 那年春天，她的继子女帮她种了花园。

entries.en: She saved the Lurex offcuts to decorate a stage costume.
entries.zh: 她留下卢勒克斯织物的边角料，用来装饰一套演出服。

entries.en: Our host in Nikko lent us an umbrella for the afternoon.
entries.zh: 在日光接待我们的人借了一把伞给我们下午用。

entries.meaningZh: 最高法院〔法国大革命前的机构〕
entries.en: The parlement rejected the petition after a lengthy hearing.
entries.zh: 经过漫长的听证，那所最高法院驳回了请愿。

entries.en: We watched Gigi while the rain kept us indoors.
entries.zh: 下雨让我们只能待在屋里，于是我们看了《Gigi》。

entries.en: In the tale, a devi shelters the travellers from a storm.
entries.zh: 传说中，一位女神庇护旅人，使他们免受风暴侵袭。

entries.en: Ms Aust brought a spare copy of the seating plan.
entries.zh: 欧斯特女士多带来了一份座位安排表。

entries.en: The tranter loaded the last crate onto his cart.
entries.zh: 那位搬运工把最后一只板条箱装上了手推车。

entries.en: The crates were damaged during transhipment at the second port.
entries.zh: 那些板条箱在第二个港口转运时受损了。

entries.en: They shared a bottle of moselle over a long dinner.
entries.zh: 他们在一顿漫长的晚餐中分饮了一瓶摩泽尔白葡萄酒。

entries.en: She left her sketchbook at the guesthouse on Elba.
entries.zh: 她把速写本落在了厄尔巴岛的旅馆里。

entries.en: Pericle noticed the loose wheel before we loaded the trolley.
entries.zh: 我们往手推车上装东西前，佩里克莱发现一个轮子松了。

entries.en: Ms McCain offered to collect the parcel on her way home.
entries.zh: 麦凯恩女士主动提出在回家路上去取包裹。

entries.en: In her play, Bergson listens patiently to the student's objections.
entries.zh: 在她的戏中，柏格森耐心地听着那名学生的异议。

entries.en: The treaty stripped the ruler of his remaining regality.
entries.zh: 那份条约剥夺了统治者剩余的王权。

entries.en: The furnisher arranged delivery of the new table and chairs.
entries.zh: 家具商安排送来了新的桌椅。

entries.en: Arlene returned the borrowed books with a box of homemade biscuits.
entries.zh: 阿琳归还借来的书时，还带来一盒自制饼干。

entries.en: The last wisher dropped a coin and hurried away from the fountain.
entries.zh: 最后一位许愿的人投下一枚硬币，匆匆离开了喷泉。

entries.en: The factory's uncompetitiveness became clear when every major customer chose cheaper suppliers.
entries.zh: 所有大客户都选择了更便宜的供应商，工厂缺乏竞争力的问题因而显露出来。

entries.en: The knight laid his misericord beside the rest of his armour.
entries.zh: 骑士把短剑放在其余盔甲旁边。

entries.en: We had a long chinwag while waiting for the paint to dry.
entries.zh: 等油漆干的时候，我们闲聊了很久。

entries.en: Her articulacy helped the group explain a complicated complaint without losing its focus.
entries.zh: 她清楚表达的能力，帮助小组有条理地说明了那起复杂的投诉。

entries.meaningZh: 盲目乐观的人〔常带贬义〕
entries.en: Even the office pollyanna looked worried when the lights went out again.
entries.zh: 灯再次熄灭时，连办公室里那个盲目乐观的人都显得担心了。

entries.en: Michelson stayed late to help us fold the display tables.
entries.zh: 迈克逊留到很晚，帮我们折起展示桌。

entries.en: The vindaloo arrived before anyone had finished choosing a drink.
entries.zh: 大家还没选好饮料，咖喱肉就端上来了。

entries.en: The faded packaging reduced the saleability of an otherwise sound product.
entries.zh: 包装褪色了，降低了一件原本完好产品的可销售性。

entries.meaningZh: 女同性恋者〔侮辱性俚语〕
entries.en: He apologised after calling his classmate a lesbo during the argument.
entries.zh: 他在争吵中用侮辱女同性恋者的脏话骂了同学，事后向对方道歉。

entries.meaningZh: 心弦；内心深处的感情〔常用复数〕
entries.en: That photograph tugged at his heartstrings more than any speech could.
entries.zh: 那张照片比任何演讲都更能触动他的心弦。

entries.meaningZh: 纵情享乐的场所〔复数，贬义〕
entries.en: He soon grew tired of the city's fleshpots and longed for quiet evenings.
entries.zh: 他很快厌倦了城里那些纵情享乐的场所，渴望安静的夜晚。

entries.en: Her old Crimplene dress still hung at the back of the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 她那条旧克林普纶连衣裙还挂在衣柜深处。

entries.meaningZh: 民族；人民〔德语借词，政治历史用语〕
entries.en: His appeal to the Volk left little room for anyone he considered an outsider.
entries.zh: 他向“人民”发出的呼吁，几乎没有给那些他认定为外来者的人留下位置。

entries.en: Ethan checked the back door before carrying in the shopping.
entries.zh: 伊桑把买来的东西搬进屋前，检查了后门。

entries.meaningZh: 达卡〔城市名，旧英语拼法〕
entries.en: The old letter gave an address in Dacca but no street number.
entries.zh: 那封旧信写着一个达卡的地址，却没有门牌号。

entries.meaningZh: 阿格里科拉〔德国历史学家及矿物学家名〕
entries.en: In the scene, Agricola examines a box left on the doorstep.
entries.zh: 在这一幕中，阿格里科拉查看了一个留在门口台阶上的箱子。

entries.en: Her toothcomb lay beside the mirror, tangled with loose hair.
entries.zh: 她的细齿梳放在镜子旁，缠着几根脱落的头发。

entries.en: The signwriter painted the final letter just before the shop opened.
entries.zh: 店铺开门前，写招牌的人刚好写完了最后一个字母。

entries.meaningZh: 废料；垃圾〔英式非正式少用词〕
entries.en: They cleared the raff from the yard before bringing in the new furniture.
entries.zh: 他们先清走院里的垃圾，再搬进新家具。

entries.en: Her imagined scene places Maginot at a desk covered with unanswered letters.
entries.zh: 她想象的场景中，马其诺在一张堆满未回复信件的桌子前。

entries.en: Kampf tied a ribbon around the suitcase to make it easier to recognise.
entries.zh: 坎普夫在行李箱上系了一条丝带，方便辨认。

entries.en: Her reading of the film owes more to Freudianism than to its director's notes.
entries.zh: 她对这部电影的解读更多受弗洛伊德学说影响，而不是依据导演的笔记。

entries.en: The company handled its forex transactions through a separate desk.
entries.zh: 公司通过一个单独的业务部门处理外汇交易。

entries.meaningZh: 女佣〔法语借词，旧式用语〕
entries.en: The bonne carried the child's coat downstairs before breakfast.
entries.zh: 早餐前，女佣把孩子的外套拿下了楼。

entries.meaningZh: 女孩；女人〔英式侮辱性俚语〕
entries.en: He regretted calling the waitress a bint as soon as he saw her expression.
entries.zh: 他一看到女服务员的表情，就后悔用侮辱女性的字眼叫她。

entries.en: We stopped for a bevvy after putting away the last of the equipment.
entries.zh: 收好最后一件装备后，我们停下来喝了一杯酒。

entries.en: Baja opened the side gate so we could carry the bench through.
entries.zh: 巴哈打开了侧门，让我们把长凳抬进去。

entries.meaningZh: 奥普拉〔美国电视主持人名〕
entries.en: The comedy imagines Oprah turning up at the wrong dinner party.
entries.zh: 那出喜剧想象了奥普拉走错晚宴的情景。

entries.meaningZh: 杰克逊维尔〔美国城市名〕
entries.en: He sent our spare bags to his older sister in Jacksonville.
entries.zh: 他把我们的备用行李包寄给了住在杰克逊维尔的姐姐。

entries.en: The letter reached Gotham after she had already left.
entries.zh: 她已经离开纽约市后，信才寄到那里。

entries.en: Gomer offered to carry the heavier bag to the station.
entries.zh: 高莫主动提出把较重的包提到车站。
